note: 私有零日 → 行为化签名模板：仅描述异常行为特征，不含利用细节特征串；公开 advisory 后可升级为细节版规则。

rules.rule: TRIDENT Agent sandbox host unexpected parent execution
rules.desc: Agent 平台沙箱宿主上，进程执行的父进程不在沙箱监管基线内（行为化异常执行面）。English: execution on an agent-platform sandbox host whose parent process is outside the sandbox supervisor baseline.
rules.condition: spawned_process and k8s.ns.label[trident-io-zone]=ml-agent and not proc.aname in (sandbox-supervisor, containerd-shim, systemd)
rules.output: sandbox unexpected parent exec proc=%proc.name parent=%proc.aname cmdline=%proc.cmdline ns=%k8s.ns.name

tuning.zh: 先按沙箱宿主实际监管进程补全父进程基线（sandbox-supervisor/containerd-shim/systemd）；上线两周内统计高频合法父进程并收敛；命中样本回传平台侧复核后再升级处置
tuning.en: Complete the parent baseline from the actual sandbox supervisor processes; observe for two weeks and absorb frequent legitimate parents; escalate response only after platform-side confirmation

rules.title: Agent 平台租户对象跨租户读取
rules.description: Agent 平台审计面：单会话主体在短时间内读取不属于自身租户的绑定/快照类对象。English: a single session principal reading tenant-scoped objects across tenant boundaries in a short window.
falsepositives: 平台运维主体的租户迁移作业（按运维账号+时间窗白名单）

tuning.zh: 阈值（5 分钟 3 次）按平台吞吐校准；对 object_class 扩展到快照/数据集导出类对象；运维迁移窗口以主体白名单收敛
tuning.en: Calibrate the threshold (3 per 5m) to platform throughput; extend object_class to snapshot/dataset-export objects; allowlist operations migration windows by subject
